text: Build step 3 of the build order in docs/design/defaults-loop.md section 12: the proposal record and its validation, 'athena status' surfacing, and the apply-as-a-job check (section 9). When introspection records of one class reach the repeat threshold across distinct jobs, Athena writes a proposed default (id, statement, applies_to, version bump, sources citing those records), validated with DefaultsModel::parse and the evidence-after-decision rule. 'athena status' lists open proposals with their sources. Accepting one runs a normal job that edits defaults.toml, so a governance change is always a verified landing and never a direct write. Rejecting one is recorded and suppresses that class until new evidence arrives. No Jev in this step. Verify with fixture records in a temporary directory.
